verdict.rationale: Synctera documents its account types: SAVING and CHECKING are Demand Deposit Accounts, plus CREDIT_CARD accounts. It also claims 'complete data visibility' shared with the bank partner and admin-controlled team access, which touches lightly on who can see the ledger. Nothing in the evidence explains whether funds sit in FBO pools or individual accounts, or where FDIC insurance attaches, and those are the core of the story. Missing for 10: FBO vs. individual account structure documentation, FDIC pass-through insurance disclosure, explicit ledger visibility/ownership model between fintech and bank, independent corroboration.
